player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: O bɛ se ka kɛ [macro micro] ye ni jatidenw ye 0-8 la.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Indices bɛɛ ka kan ka kɛ 0 ani 8 cɛ.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: A tɛ se ka don, a bɛ bɔ walima a man bon.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Kɔnɔna ye mɔgɔ caman sɔrɔ ka ban.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: O tigi ka kan ka tulon kɛ mikɔrɔtabuli wɛrɛ la.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: An ye mikɔrɔgaramu sɔrɔ ka ban.

game_action.played: Jokelani {player_id} daa jagaya kɔnɔti kɛcɛya {macro_idx}, seli {micro_idx} (daraka {row}, kɔlɔmɛ {col}). Jokelani {opponent_id} yɛn bɛ jagaya kɔnɔti {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Jiginni {player_id} ye Tic Tac Toe laban sɔrɔ!
